ON SEPTEMBER 1, 2009 A LOADER BEING UTILIZED CAUGHT FIRE WHILE INSTALLING A CULVERT IN A WETLANDS AREA. THE FIRE CAUSED AN ESTIMATED 20 GALLONS OF HYDRAULIC OILS AND 3 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL TO BE RELEASED FROM THE LOADER. SEMINOLE COUNTY ENVIRONMENTAL PERSONNEL AND SEMINOLE COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT/SHOT RESPONDED AND SECURED THE RELEASE. THE RELEASE WAS ISOLATED TO SITE SOILS IMMEDIATELY ADJACENT TO WETLANDS. TO DATE, THE R/P, THE R/P'S INSURANCE COMPANY AND THE PROPERTY OWNER HAVE FAILED TO TAKE ACTION TO CLEANUP THE RELEASE. R/P PROVIDED SERVICES ON BEHALF OF PROPERTY OWNER. BER TO PROCEED WITH CLEANUP TO REMOVE THE THREAT TO THE WETLANDS. THIS RELEASE IS OPA-90 ELIGIBLE FOR REIMBURSEMENT DUE TO WATERFLOW FROM THIS LOCATION REACHING THE ST. JOHN'S RIVER. IF R/P AND PROPERTY OWNER CONTINUE TO BE NON-RESPONSIVE, OBER TO PURSUE REIMBURSEMENT UNDER OPA-90.

CALLER IS REPORTING THAT A LEAK IN A TANK RELEASED 1200 GALLONS OF SULFURIC ACID INTO SECONDARY CONTAINMENT. DURING THE LAST COUPLE OF DAYS( 12/22/05 & 12/23/05)THE WATTENBERG GAS PROCESSING PLANT HAS BEEN RECEIVING LARGE VOLUMES OF HYDROCARBON SLUG LIQUIDS IN THE INLET FEED GAS PIPELINE SYSTEM THAT DELIVERS HYDROCARBON GAS TO THE WATTENBERG PLANT. THESE LARGER THAN NORMAL VOLUMES OF HYDROCARBON LIQUIDS ARE A RESULT OF KERR MCGEES PIPELINE PIGGING OPERATIONS ON THEIR FIELD GAS PIPELINE GATHERING SYSTEMS.KERR MCGEE DELIVERS GAS TO THE WATTENBERG GAS PLANT FOR PROCESSING. THE HIGHER THAN NORMAL VOLUMES OF SLUG HYDROCARBON LIQUIDS HAS RESULTED IN A REDUCED CAPACITY FOR STORAGE ROOM IN OUR PLANT THEREFORE CAUSING US TO HAVE TO FLARE HYDROCARBON GAS THROUGH OUR PLANT FLARE STACK. DURING THE 24 PERIOD FROM 8AM 12/23 THROUGH 8AM 12/24/05 WE VENTED GAS THROUGH OUR PLANT FLARE STACK FOR APPROXIMATELY 6 HOURS RESULTING IN A RELEASE OF 13.8 LBS OF NO2 EMISSIONS.

WINDS WERE OUT OF THE SE AT 10KTS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE, FEATHERING THROUGHOUT THE IMAGE WOULD AGREE WITH THE WIND MOVEMENT. UNCERTAINTIES: THERE WAS HEAVY CLOUD COVER THROUGHOUT THE ANOMALY EXTENT, AND NUMEROUS FALSE POSITIVES FROM CLOUD SHADOWS, SO WE WERE UNABLE TO FULLY ACCOUNT FOR THE TOTAL ANOMALY.
